description:
Calculate the Phase Voltage (V_ph) for a system with a Line Voltage (V_LL) of 480 Volts using the Electrical Engineering Calculations app.

1. Open the app and navigate to the 'Line to Phase' (or 'Line to phase voltage/current') converter.
2. Ensure the mode is set to Voltage (if applicable) and direction is Line to Phase.
3. Enter 480 in the Line Voltage field.
4. Calculate the result.
5. Verify the Phase Voltage is approximately 277 V.
6. Save a screenshot of the result to '/sdcard/tasks/three_phase_voltage_conversion_result.png'.
